text:
zoe_am: Heads-up — NovaLabs (NL-320) disputed INV-2026-07: they see an unexpected prorated reserved commit line during their model migration. Invoice snippet they attached: 

zoe_am: ```
INV-2026-07 | NL-320 | Reserved Commit (monthly) | $10,000.00
INV-2026-07 | NL-320-mig | Reserved Prorated (07/09 10:15-10:45) | $2,300.00  <-- customer says this duplicates commit
INV-2026-07 | NL-320 | Burst (07/09 10:20-10:25) | $180.00
```

matt_ops: Checked allocator + migration logs. The migration service created temp tag `nl:mig-20260709` at 10:14; proration job ran at 10:16 and treated the temp tag as a separate bucket, emitting a prorate line. Metering shows total tokens remain inside the monthly commit. No extra token consumption.

matt_ops: TL;DR: bookkeeping/proration race created an orphan prorate. Root cause: proration job doesn't coalesce short-lived migration tags back into parent commit.

elia_billing: Proposed customer remediation:
- Remove prorated reserved line: credit $2,300
- Waive burst fee: $180
- Small goodwill concession for disruption: $120
Provisional total credit = $2,600.

sam_fin: I approve provisional credit up to $2,650. Create FIN-8100 to track. Finance requires an infra backfill ticket and RCA paragraph saved to the credit record before finalizing.

zoe_am: Draft customer note: "Thanks — we found a proration race during your migration that created an extra prorated reserved line. We've applied a provisional $2,600 credit and will issue a corrected invoice after we backfill meter records. This is a one-time correction and will not change your committed profile going forward. ETA for finalized invoice: 48 business hours." OK to send?

elia_billing: Send it. I'll BCC legal on the corrected invoice template and record FIN-8100.

infra-bot: INFRA-56000 created to patch proration coalescing logic and run backfill for NL-320 (07/09 window). ETA 36h. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-56000

matt_ops: After backfill we'll validate regenerated allocations and then finance can finalize FIN-8100. I'll open a follow-up to add a nightly check for orphan prorates.

billing-bot: Metering alert posted: `migration-prorate-flag` NL-320 2026-07-09T10:16Z. Candidate orphan prorate detected.

sam_fin: Noted FIN-8100 provisional approval. Please link INFRA-56000 when backfill completes for final signoff.

zoe_am: Customer acknowledged provisional adjustment and asked for corrected invoice. Will update when backfill done. :white_check_mark:
